copy_policy: Exact bytes and file modification times preserved; no measurement rewriting or redaction during packaging.

privacy_check.note: Configured private endpoint values were used only in memory and are not exported. Public upstream banners and systemd unit names remain intact.

selection: Finite allowlist declared in procedure/package-final.py; unlisted files are not copied.

excluded_source_paths.flight/: Local workspace, cloned NASA sources, runtime database, SSH material, guest disks and binaries; never exported.
excluded_source_paths.setup-qemu/: Image-candidate exploration; final image identity is retained in setup-qemu-final and setup-qemu-image-final.
excluded_source_paths.setup-qemu-image/: Interrupted preparation and diagnostic material outside the completed final campaign.
excluded_source_paths.setup-qemu-image-retry-1/: Interrupted retry and process diagnostics outside the completed final campaign.
excluded_source_paths.run-qemu-campaign.py: Duplicate coordinator; exact preserved copy is exported from procedure/.
excluded_source_paths.run-physical-campaign.py: Duplicate coordinator; exact preserved copy is exported from procedure/.
excluded_source_paths.qemu-orchestration.log: Console progress duplicate; complete structured orchestration receipt is exported.
excluded_source_paths.physical-orchestration.log: Console progress duplicate; complete structured orchestration receipt is exported.
excluded_source_paths.anything not on the finite allowlist: Not part of this publication selection; no automatic additions.
excluded_source_paths.private local HTTP server logs outside c: Contain local launch-session credentials; neither located nor exported by this script.
